card.title: Xbox Series X powers off during gameplay repair

source.title: Xbox Series X powers off during gameplay repair

claims.statement: Xbox Series X shutting off once gameplay starts usually has a failing SSD; clone the original M.2 to a new drive.
Series X internal SSDs only work in another Series X if cloned, and not in a Series S.

procedure: Clone the internal SSD to a replacement M.2.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
